requirements.normative_requirement: Each lease uses a fixed-virtual-size qcow2 overlay over a pinned read-only base image.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Unbounded disk growth and mutable base contamination
requirements.primary_verification: Sparse/truncate/rename/hardlink/reflink write campaign until quota; base image digest unchanged.

requirements.normative_requirement: The daemon reserves host storage and enforces a minimum-free-space gate before lease acquisition.
requirements.primary_verification: Low-space simulation and concurrent lease acquisition prove admission is rejected before QEMU start.

requirements.normative_requirement: Special files and unsupported inode types are rejected during import and export.
requirements.primary_verification: Create every unsupported inode type inside the guest and prove export rejects the change set.
